title: Siege of Breslau (1757)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Breslau (1757)", at revision 1370739765, opens: "The siege of Breslau was a siege in the Third Silesian War that began on 7 December 1757 and ended on 19 December 1757. After the defeat at Leuthen, the Austrians withdrew into Breslau. The combined Austro-French garrison of approximately 17,000 men, commanded by Lieutenant General Field Marshal Soloman Sprecher von Bernegg, faced a Prussian army commanded by Frederick the Great." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q10751225, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "siege in 1757". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
